option_relations.rationale: Cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma is a broader term that encompasses telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma
Carcinoma erysipeloides is a type of cutaneous metastasis from breast carcinoma, which is related to telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma
Telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma is a direct match for the leaf label
Carcinoma en cuirasse is a different variant of breast carcinoma metastasis and does not match the leaf label

decisions.rationale: Carcinoma en cuirasse is a sclerodermiform variant of breast carcinoma metastasis, but no matching leaf label is found
